header.description: What: how a vehicle was destroyed and which of its parts are destroyed are simulation state every renderer reads the same way (CE-4670 vehicle appearance VA-S1; docs/designs/vehicle-appearance/DESIGN_Vehicle_Appearance_State.md §3a, §6c). On basic-desert a friendly M1 ('Tank', BasicVehicleSop) kills an idle enemy T-72 ('Enemy Tank', 240 m north) with its gun; a neutral T-72 ('Tracked Tank', 400 m east of it) starts with its LEFT track destroyed (PartDamage RunningGearL 255) and full health. Judge: the Enemy Tank's Health owner decides its kill kind on the killing hit (Health.Destruction, from the part hit and the type's stowage — the T-72 keeps its ammunition in the hull carousel under the turret, so the M1's hull hit is a Catastrophic kill, the turret thrown), the same on every node; the Tracked Tank keeps its destroyed track (the mobility kill, drawn dark on our 3D map), lives and has no kill kind. Fail: the wreck carries no kill kind, or the Tracked Tank loses its track damage or is killed.
